responsibility: Hosts the main gengtype driver that coordinates source scanning, state-file loading, and output generation. It manages the input file lists, language directories, backup/output files, plugin mode, and the final emission of type, root, and RTL-traversal tables after the parser and state logic have built the global type graph.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the gengtype tool, paired with gcc/gengtype.h. Unlike the header, this file contains the executable driver and operational logic: it owns the global state, parses command-line options and input/state files, invokes parsing, plugin handling, and state read/write, and emits the generated GC/PCH/root/RTL-traversal outputs.
